newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GA brings computer cargo insurance to Singapore.
newsitem.headline: GA brings computer cargo insurance to Singapore.

text.p: Cargo businesses in Singapore can now purchase insurance policies through a computer in two minutes, a marketing executive from a major Britain-based insurance firm said.
"It is an innovative business methodology which provides policies in their office on the spot," Petrina Lim, marketing service manager of General Accident Insurance (GA), told Reuters.
The service, PC Cargonet, was launched in Singapore on Wednesday.
GA called it the world's first windows-based system designed to help cargo businesses generate fast cargo insurance with a computer, printer and modem.
The new technology also gives clients on-line access to a worldwide network of claims settling agents, premium statistics as well as the Lloyd's Shipping index, Lim said.
